card.name: Digits inside phone and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (mostly 5 or 8) inside a long number, such as the exchange part of a toll-free phone number or the middle of an ISBN, in contact or reference lines.

modes.label: Phone number digit
modes.description: A digit right after 800- in a toll-free number given for drug information or REMS courses.
modes.example: obtain further information on the opioid analgesic REMS and for a list of accredited REMS CME/CE, call 800-<<5>>03-0784,

modes.label: ISBN digit
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a long ISBN/UPC code in a product listing.
modes.example: 2nd Edition. - Type: Other () - Category: > Home Schooling - ISBN / UPC: 9781606<<8>>21923/16

card.plain: It fires on a digit partway through a phone number or ISBN code.
